platform: CKUT 90.3 FM Montreal Music Department Digital MP3 and Physical Airplay Route
manual_review_reason: CKUT accepts digital releases by email only when they meet the station's library criteria: 320-kbps MP3 files, no singles, and at least three distinct tracks except for 7-inch vinyl. The public page does not fully specify the preferred digital delivery mechanism, attachment-size limits, required metadata, release window, rights language, content labels, AI-origin policy or response timing. A human must confirm the current rules, select an eligible MarcsMusic album or EP, prepare the permitted files or delivery link and release information, verify rights and content labels, and send manually. Optional CD, cassette or vinyl delivery also requires manual handling.

platform: CJAM 99.1 FM Windsor Music Director Digital Album and EP Download-Link Route
manual_review_reason: CJAM is digital-only and requires an email to its Music Director containing artist and release information plus a reliable download link. Spotify links and direct MP3 attachments are rejected; releases must contain at least four original tracks, use MP3 or AAC at 192 kbps minimum or FLAC, and include complete embedded tags. A human must confirm current requirements, select an eligible MarcsMusic album or EP, prepare a reliable Dropbox, WeTransfer or Google Drive download, verify file quality, tags, rights and content labels, and send manually. The destination is a publicly authorized role mailbox hosted on Gmail rather than the station domain, so official-page consistency must be rechecked immediately before use.
